therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: selective delivery of cytotoxic agent to CD30-positive lymphoma cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: objective response rate by independent review group

subgroup_findings: 82% B symptom resolution in patients with baseline B symptoms
safety_signals: 16/58 patients discontinued due to adverse events
Notable cardiac events including MI, arrhythmias, AV block
Hematologic toxicities including neutropenia and lymphopenia
results.dose_information: 1.8 mg/kg every 3 weeks by IV infusion

context.duration: treatment up to 12 months, follow-up up to 7 years
